title: 第7章 这一波为父替你装了第8章 慎重老实人绝不出头
content_zh:
“也不知父亲那边怎么样了...”
大雨倾泻而下。
许小凡的身形在雨幕之下快速移动着，眼中尽是浓郁到化不开的担忧之色。
他想回去，可他找不到回去的路。
而且估么着回去，也是送人头的下场。
如今之际，只能是先前往青州城...
三个时辰后。
在雨幕下狂暴的许小凡突然停了下来，定睛打量着不远处的山洞。
见大雨没有停歇的意思，而丹田气海中的真元也消耗的差不多了，他便准备进去暂歇片刻。
可走到山洞前，却又犹豫起来。
里边有火光，明显有人。
如果是杨家人，那岂不是自投罗网了？
这时，山洞里传来笑声：“这位兄台，外边大雨不好赶路，还是进来暂避片刻吧。”
许小凡思考再三，还是走进了山洞。
他必须得找个地方恢复真元。
否则在没有真元的情况下，很容易就会变成山中妖兽的宵夜。
况且他手里还握着系统前辈奖励的传送符。
情况不妙可以立马跑路。
如此想着，许小凡踱步走了进去。
山洞并不算特别大，一进去便能看见一名华服少年与一名墨衣白胡子老者正在烤着不知名妖兽的肉。

许小凡直接自报家门：“在下许辰。”
那少年愣了片刻，旋即才热情起身：“原来是许辰兄，在下李宝，这位是家师冉离，冉先生。”
许小凡笑着说：“叨扰二位了。”
李宝一摆手：“那里的话，本就是无主之地。”
许小凡回以一个微笑，并不想多言。
转而找了一个离二人最远的位置，盘膝恢复真元。
当然，他依旧分出部分心神在观察二人。
没过多久。
李宝提着一串肉喊道：“许兄，要过来整一口吗？”
许小凡睁开眼，客气婉拒：“已经吃过了，多谢李兄好意。”
李宝尴尬一笑，明显想要继续攀谈：“许兄弟这是要去哪？”
许小凡毫不犹豫开口：“北洲。”
李宝嘴角抽搐。
北洲距此地何止万里？
就算一名神藏高手，不计代价燃烧精血运用虚空传送，恐怕都得一个月才能到。
content_en:
"I don't know what's going on with my father..."
Rain poured down.
Xu Xiaofan's figure moved quickly under the rain curtain, his eyes filled with worry that was so intense that it couldn't be dispelled.
He wanted to go back, but he couldn't find his way back.
And if you go back, you'll end up getting killed.
Now, the only choice is to go to Qingzhou City first...
Three hours later.
Xu Xiaofan, who was furious under the rain, suddenly stopped and looked intently at the cave not far away.
Seeing that the heavy rain had no intention of stopping, and the real energy in the qi sea in Dantian was almost exhausted, he was ready to go in and rest for a while.
But when he reached the cave, he hesitated again.
There was fire inside, and someone was obviously there.
If it were the Yang family, wouldn't they have fallen into a trap?
At this time, laughter came from the cave: "Brother, it's raining heavily outside and it's difficult to travel. It's better to come in and take shelter for a while."
Xu Xiaofan thought again and again and walked into the cave.
He had to find a place to recover his true energy.
Otherwise, without true energy, it would easily become a midnight snack for the monsters in the mountains.
Moreover, he still holds in his hand the teleportation talisman rewarded by the system's seniors.
If the situation goes bad, you can run away immediately.
With this in mind, Xu Xiaofan walked in.
The cave is not particularly big. As soon as you enter, you can see a young man in rich clothes and an old man in black clothes and white beard roasting the meat of an unknown monster.
Xu Xiaofan directly announced his family name: "I am Xu Chen."
The young man was stunned for a moment, then stood up enthusiastically: "It turns out to be brother Xu Chen, this is Li Bao. This is our master Ran Li, Mr. Ran."
Xu Xiaofan smiled and said, "I'm sorry to bother you two."
Li Baoyi waved his hand: "If it is there, it is a no-owner's land."
Xu Xiaofan smiled back and didn't want to say anything.
Instead, he found a position farthest away from the two of them, crossed his legs and restored his true energy.
Of course, he still used part of his mind to observe the two of them.
It didn't take long.
Li Bao held up a skewer of meat and shouted, "Brother Xu, do you want to come over and take a bite?"
Xu Xiaofan opened his eyes and politely declined: "I've already eaten. Thank you Brother Li for your kindness."
Li Bao smiled awkwardly, obviously wanting to continue the conversation: "Where are you going, Brother Xu?"
Xu Xiaofan said without hesitation: "Beizhou."
The corners of Li Bao's mouth twitched.
Beizhou is more than ten thousand miles away from here?
Even if a Shenzang master burns blood essence and uses void teleportation at any cost, it would probably take him a month to arrive.
